title: Smoked Skillet Melon
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring smoky flavors and earthy undertones, perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Cut the melon into bite-sized pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with smoked earthy spice blend.
Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the melon is tender.
While the melon is roasting, heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the roasted melon to the skillet and squeeze with lemon juice.
Serve the melon hot, garnished with additional smoked earthy spice blend if desired.
